findings.message: #score has data-volume="0.78" (-2.2 dB) and a GSAP tween on `volume`. Tween values are absolute: they REPLACE this gain rather than scale it, so wherever the tween names a value the clip plays at that value, not at -2.2 dB.
findings.fixHint: Write the tween's targets in the same absolute gain (e.g. `volume: 1.95`, not `volume: 1`), or reset data-volume to 1 and let the tween carry the level on its own.

findings.message: <div id="s1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="s1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
